expires_today.title: Urban Warfare Flash Bundle
expires_today.description: Build intense urban warfare scenes with nearly 600 assets!
expires_today.long_description:
Build grounded city conflict zones, tactical neighborhoods, military outposts, and cinematic combat encounters with the Urban Warfare Flash Bundle by KitBash3D. Featuring a versatile mix of detailed environments, transport vehicles, mechs, city cars, and sci-fi hero assets, this collection gives artists everything they need to craft high-impact scenes across modern, near-future, and sci-fi settings. Fully customizable and built for speed, these assets are designed to fit seamlessly into your workflow. Compatible with Blender, Unreal, Maya, and more. Plus, your purchase helps support Girls Who Code!

Keys expire. Please redeem before September 30th, 2026.

expires_today.title: Python, Rust, and Data by O'Reilly
expires_today.description: Creativity meets data with Python and Rust
expires_today.long_description: Master the most in-demand skills in tech with the Python, Rust, and Data Bundle by O'Reilly. Trust in the safety of Rust and the flexibility of Python within this comprehensive, data-driven library. Get expert insights on the most popular coding languages from courses like Python for Data Analysis, 3e, Learning Python, 6e, Programming Rust, 2e, and more before summer ends! Deepen your understanding whether you’re new to tech or an experienced professional, and help support Code for America with your purchase!

expires_today.title: AI, ML, and Decision Engines by Pragmatic
expires_today.long_description: Break into the ever-growing world of AI, machine learning, and decision engines with a 15+ title bundle of eBooks curated by the experts at The Pragmatic Bookshelf! Learn time-efficient coding techniques from Process Over Magic: Beyond Vibe Coding, dip your toes into the latest in-demand skill sets with A Common-Sense Guide to AI Engineering, discover what content resonates with your audience from Next-Level A/B Testing, and so much more. Save big on the tools you need to succeed, and support Save the Children's emergency response in Venezuela with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: From Rivers to Fjords - Explore the Worlds of Basic Roleplaying by Chaosium
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Dive into the roleplaying worlds of Chaosium in this ebook bundle full of roleplaying adventures, environments, and rulebooks! Get started with the fundamentals in instructional manuals like Basic Roleplaying: Universal Game Engine and Basic Roleplaying: Creatures! Enter the demi-monde and solve magical mysteries in Rivers of London! Turn back the clock to the age of heroes in Age of Vikings! This bundle has all the sourcebooks, outlines, and creation manuals to guide you on your adventures, so grab it now at the price of your choosing and support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before August 18th, 2027.

Keys are redeemable through the DriveThruRPG website.

expires_tomorrow.title: Massive Unreal Engine Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Create a scene with environmental assets
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Game developers, start building your worlds in Unreal Engine with 60 modular environment kits from the creatives at Laya Design. This massive library includes fresh environments and essential assets in a variety of themes like Sci-Fi, Futurist, Tropical, Snowy, Medieval, and more! Armed with consistent style across the board, these assets easily mix and match without feeling clunky or out of place. Unlock thousands of unique modular meshes, foliage, and props to build large-scale worlds that feel truly lived in. Pay what you want for ready-to-use Unreal assets, and help support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before May 26th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Mammoth Chronicles STL Mega Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Dazzle your players with this epic bundle of 131 premium fantasy STL miniatures and 9 unforgettable 5e adventures. Playtested by a dedicated community, Mammoth Chronicles is a library of short plug-and-play adventures. Mammoth Chronicles was the first Kickstarter by Mammoth Factory, best known for their highly anticipated 5e Fairytales Kickstarter - Fateless. Pay what you want and help support Child's Play with your purchase!
